title: eupatorium ballotifolium var. typicum
intro: Eupatorium ballotifolium var. typicum, commonly known as White Snakeroot, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, native to North America. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cold, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of White Snakeroot include expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory actions, making it useful in treating coughs, sore throats, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of White Snakeroot include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
